decision_context.selection_rationale: Version governance applies to both internal and public REST consumers during staged migration.
decision_context.naming_convention_summary: Version labels and deprecation headers follow one policy across all endpoints.
decision_context.threshold_method_summary: Version support windows and operational thresholds are derived from consumer adoption telemetry and support cost.

threshold_policy.latency_target_derivation: Latency targets are inherited from current SLO and adjusted for dual-version overhead.
threshold_policy.availability_target_derivation: Availability target is set by highest criticality consumer still on supported versions.
threshold_policy.timeout_budget_derivation: Timeout budgets include version-routing overhead and dependency variance.
threshold_policy.capacity_headroom_derivation: Capacity headroom accounts for overlap period where multiple versions run concurrently.
threshold_policy.payload_limit_derivation: Payload limits are fixed by backwards-compat payload envelope guarantees.
threshold_policy.concurrency_limit_derivation: Concurrency limits are derived from canary traffic split and rollback surge scenarios.
threshold_policy.retry_backoff_derivation: Retry policy is derived from cross-version idempotency guarantees and dependency backpressure.
threshold_policy.delivery_semantics_derivation: Delivery semantics must remain consistent during version overlap to prevent client divergence.
